cleanup.action: Send an orderly interrupt to the foreground uvicorn process; retain the execution log.
Stop without deleting the named volume; volume deletion requires separate evidence-preservation approval.
Stop Gradle daemons; retain reports and artifact hashes before deleting build directories.
Remove gateway generated build output only after evidence binding.
Preview only. The --apply confirmation path is outside routine developer cleanup.

storage_rules: Track names and non-secret placeholders only; never store actual secret values in this JSON or Markdown supplement.
Keep local .env files, credentials, tokens, TOTP seeds and database passwords outside version-controlled documentation, fixtures, manifests, lock files and screenshots.
Do not compile server or provider secrets into Android BuildConfig, APK/AAB assets or source. Android receives only non-secret origins and role/build metadata.
Do not emit secrets, authorization headers, precise location, raw image/audio, passwords, TOTP, recovery codes or raw exception messages into logs or evidence.
Use an approved local credential store or deployment secret mechanism; separate development, test and production credentials.
On suspected exposure, revoke or rotate first and add a new incident/review record; do not rewrite historical evidence to hide the event.
Bind non-secret model, threshold, class-order, schema and origin configuration to exact path and SHA-256 before relying on it.
environment_and_secret_contract.validation_error_rule: Missing, malformed, non-loopback or insecure values must fail closed where the named config source requires them; no production-safe claim is made before W3/W5 execution evidence.

common: Keep behavior changes traceable to policy, requirement, design and test IDs.
Fail closed on absent or untrusted auth, consent, sensor, model, network and database state.
Give resources and concurrency work an explicit owner, lifetime, cancellation and close point.
Use named constants and explicit units for thresholds, time, distance, byte size and coordinates.
Add normal, refusal, revocation, offline, duplicate, timeout and recovery boundary tests for changed behavior.
Never claim formatter, lint, static-analysis, build or test PASS without an append-only execution record bound to exact source bytes.

rules: Follow the Gradle/JVM 21 and Android module configuration.
Bind coroutine, callback, camera, sensor, location, microphone and upload work to the walking-session lifecycle.
Represent UNKNOWN or missing evidence explicitly and cancel unsafe work rather than inferring success.
Keep server/provider secrets out of application source and BuildConfig.
Follow the Gradle/JVM 21 and Android module configuration.
Keep authentication, recovery and high-risk action state transitions explicit and deny by default.
Do not log IDs, passwords, TOTP, recovery codes, access/recovery tokens, device identifiers or raw exception messages.
Preserve API-origin and step-up checks at every high-risk call site.
Use the Node >=22 <23 and TypeScript 6.0.3 package contract.
Keep request parsing, authorization, privacy, proxy and persistence boundaries typed and fail closed.
Use bounded retries/timeouts and stable request/correlation identifiers without forwarding secret-bearing input.
Hold exclusive-file locks for the entire protected mutation lifetime and do not replace the locked inode.

python.scope: Backend, migrations, model and repository tooling
rules: Use four-space indentation, explicit boundary types and small single-purpose functions.
Keep FastAPI request validation, service logic and SQLAlchemy session/transaction ownership separate.
Represent schema changes as append-only Alembic revisions; never edit an applied migration to rewrite history.
Keep model/config provenance and SHA binding separate from quality, device performance and deployment eligibility.

append_only_rules: Create a new review/execution record for each run; never overwrite a prior result, reviewer decision or failure.
Bind every review record to exact source/config/lock path and SHA-256, command, environment class, time, result, finding and unresolved risk.
Do not invent a second person. A self-review must say SELF_REVIEW and cannot close a gate requiring an independent or external reviewer.
Blocking and major findings remain open until a later append-only correction and re-review record identifies their closure evidence.
Rollback uses a new revert/change record and new verification evidence; it does not delete the superseded record.
Secret or personal-data exposure is redacted from the record, rotated/revoked separately and referenced by a non-secret incident ID.
